validator_usability_observations.detail: SKILL.md P1-P6 and references/results-contract.md require nine records; this assignment's fence permits six items. Plan, cases, per-criterion review and per-check results were folded into named sections of verification-results.md and findings.json rather than written as separate files. SKILL.md:89 says 'Where the evaluation has authored cases, run them' and shows the command, but does not say where an evaluator's own cases should live when the candidate ships none, nor that evals.json - the shape the authoring contract actually mandates - is not the runner's input format. Two different file formats share the word 'cases'. references/runner-interface.md documents the format well; the entrypoint should route to it explicitly for this path.

The case-level 'files' key is permitted and documented as resolving relative to the evals directory, but run_cases.py never reads it, so an evaluator can believe fixtures are being staged when nothing is. assets/verification-results.md offers no row for an evaluation whose plan arrived as an assignment packet rather than as an authored validation-plan.json. Positively: the graders behaved exactly as references/runner-interface.md documents on the known-answer fixtures, including every INDETERMINATE case, and the header's authority and custody_note fields made the custody boundary hard to overlook.
